<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>Community Feed</title>
<style>
.feed-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; }
.post-card { border: 1px solid #d0d7de; padding: 12px; border-radius: 6px; }
.tag-list { display: flex; gap: 6px; margin-top: 8px; }
.tag-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: #eef1f4; }
.mod-tag-block { display: none; border: 0; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; font-size: 12px; }
[data-role="moderator"] .tag-chip:hover .mod-tag-block,
[data-role="moderator"] .tag-chip:focus-within .mod-tag-block { display: inline-flex; }
.tag-chip[data-blocked="true"] { opacity: 0.5; text-decoration: line-through; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<main id="feed" class="feed-list" data-role="member"></main>
<script src="moderation.js"></script>
</body>
</html>

checks.run: node -e "const assert=require('node:assert/strict');const {renderFeed}=require('./moderation.js');function makeDoc(){class El{constructor(t){this.tagName=t;this.children=[];this.attrs={};this.listeners={};this.className='';this.textContent='';}setAttribute(k,v){this.attrs[k]=String(v);}getAttribute(k){return this.attrs[k]??null;}appendChild(c){this.children.push(c);}addEventListener(e,fn){(this.listeners[e]??=[]).push(fn);}click(){for(const fn of this.listeners.click||[])fn();}set innerHTML(_){this.children=[];}findAll(pred,out=[]){if(pred(this))out.push(this);for(const c of this.children)c.findAll(pred,out);return out;}}return {El,createElement:(t)=>new El(t)};}const doc=makeDoc();const posts=[{id:'p1',title:'Hello',tags:['news','events']}];const mRoot=doc.createElement('main');mRoot.setAttribute('data-role','member');renderFeed(mRoot,posts,{document:doc,role:'member'});assert.equal(mRoot.findAll(e=>e.getAttribute('data-mod-control')==='block-tag').length,0,'member sees no mod controls');assert.equal(mRoot.findAll(e=>e.className==='tag-chip').length,2);const modRoot=doc.createElement('main');const prompts=[];let next='   ';const state=renderFeed(modRoot,posts,{document:doc,role:'moderator',prompt:(msg)=>{prompts.push(msg);return next;}});const ctrls=modRoot.findAll(e=>e.getAttribute('data-mod-control')==='block-tag');assert.equal(ctrls.length,2);ctrls[0].click();assert.equal(prompts[0],'Reason for Block?');assert.equal(state.blockedTags.length,0,'blank reason must not block');next='off-topic spam';ctrls[1].click();assert.deepEqual(state.blockedTags,[{postId:'p1',tag:'events',reason:'off-topic spam'}]);const chips=modRoot.findAll(e=>e.className==='tag-chip');assert.equal(chips[1].getAttribute('data-blocked'),'true');"
